review.note: Reran on a private build of the current tree (ui4-g3/dist-base, port 1643). vitest designTokens + motion: 29 pass. First run of hover-emphasis, appearance and editor-toolbar (ui4-g3/t177-pw.log, machine heavily loaded, 29 min): 29 pass, 4 fail. Two failures are the K1 dock tests in editor-toolbar.spec.ts, which belong to T182 (in progress, owns that spec), not H3. One is a page.goto timeout from the load. One is a single crawl exception: the Snapshot dialog's Cancel had no scale when sampled. Rerun of the crawl and the narrow-bar test (t177-pw2.log): both pass, 'H3 exceptions: 0' over 1247 controls / 537 text on 20 screens. So the Cancel exception was a load timing flake. Flag for H4: the 220 ms hover sample can miss under heavy load. Also read the CSS changes as listed in the done note (Snapshot border gone, popover/research hover weights deleted, [data-highlighted] joins the shared rule). Chromium only, as stated.

log.note: H3 shipped (Chromium only). CSS: deleted the width-changing hover weight in popover.css (data-popover-item) and research.css (.template-choice strong); removed hover underline/border-colour (.settings-text-action, .template-delete, .settings-button, .fragment-link in fragments.css); Snapshot is a plain text+icon control (border and !important padding gone, padding var(--space-2)); shared block now also fires on [data-highlighted]/.is-highlighted (keyboard-highlighted menu/dropdown rows); exclusion list fixed: .toolbar-icon:not([data-popover-item]) (More-menu rows are text) and .format-bar .extract (icon-only, its label span is display:none; crawler now ignores display:none text). Tests: crawl in tests/hover-emphasis.spec.ts now asserts for EVERY crawled text control (hover sampled 220 ms after landing) stroke>0.2px with colour == text colour, scale 1.04, hover weight == rest weight, and for every icon-only control no stroke/no scale: 'H3 exceptions: 0' (run6.log); Snapshot border-top-width 0px asserted. Fail-first: pre-H3 build (T175 tree, ui4-h3/failfirst3.log) -> 37 exceptions (popover/dropdown 400->600 weight, Snapshot border) and the border assertion fails. Existing specs updated for the new rule (registered): editor-toolbar.spec.ts (More row emphasis is now a text stroke), appearance.spec.ts (pressed Snapshot is 1.04*0.99=1.0296). Pass on the final build: vitest designTokens+motion; hover-emphasis 2, appearance 19, editor-toolbar 9, alignment 7, sidebar-selection 7, motion-u7 2, split-view 16, projects-screen 39, research 12, fragments-panel 6, motion-u5 3, motion-u6 1, accessibility 4 (some of those on the pre-final build; the final build re-ran hover-emphasis, appearance, editor-toolbar, alignment, sidebar-selection, motion-u7, split-view). Not done / notes: App.tsx not touched (CSS-only); label rows were tested via the crawl exclusion of label scale (labels are excluded from the 1.04 assertion in the crawl, stroke asserted). .group-title.selected weight 500/600 doubling rule is B1's. editor.css .prose-issue-dismiss and .footnote-source left for H4 after G3.
